# Synthetic DungeonJournal

A made-up ForeverDungeonJournal addon (one dungeon, The Test Mine) in the real addon's file layout,
for forge-data's `forge data dungeons` test (rust/crates/forge-data/tests/data/dungeons.rs), read over
the compiler's fixture data (tests/fixtures/dsl/data). Written by hand; nothing to regenerate.
